{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693897998,"sessionID":"ses_e23ea0be1ffe6pg54KRcMlJoFF","part":{"id":"prt_1dc179ef9001bvGdd2dyJorbSA","messageID":"msg_1dc177dca001YWCxCVYrXVV61T","sessionID":"ses_e23ea0be1ffe6pg54KRcMlJoFF","type":"text","text":"I found and fixed four faults. All four customer-facing services were at 0% errors from minute 76 until the shift ended at 120, and no other faults appeared.\n\n| # | Cause | Fix | Done by |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **profile-db** primary node unreachable (from minute -18). It also set off a wave of caller retries that kept it overloaded after the failover. This was why partner-api was failing about 96% of requests. | Failover at 13. At 51, 60% throttle for 3 minutes to stop the retry wave, then removed. | ~56 |\n| 2 | **bundles-svc** memory leak since deploy v108 (memory rose steadily, then processes kept crashing). | Rollback v108 at 18. | 23 |\n| 3 | **promo-cache** deploy v68 fixed its connection pool at 4 connections (minute -36). The errors passed up through currency-svc and notifications-svc to admin-portal, costing about 4% of its $16,800/min. This was the most expensive fault. | Scaled promo-cache up to 12 replicas first so retries during the rollback wouldn't overload it. Rolled back v68 at 48, then scaled back to the normal 8 (free). | ~53 |\n| 4 | New fault during the shift: **emails-svc** config change cfg-52 at minute 53 cut its rate limit from 5000/s to 50/s. partner-api errors climbed back to about 75%. | Reverted cfg-52 at 65. A retry wave kept emails-svc overloaded, so I throttled it 60% for 3 minutes at 71, then removed the throttle. | ~76 |\n\nRemaining costs:\n- **Slow first fix:** admin-portal stayed at about 4% errors until about minute 53, so roughly $570–670/min for the first 53 minutes. I worked on the partner-api fault before tracing this one.\n- **Extra replicas:** the 4 extra promo-cache replicas ran for about 23 minutes at $3 each per minute.\n- **Throttles and rollbacks:** the short throttles and the rollback periods failed some requests while they ran.\n\nI didn't apply any mitigation to a service that didn't need it, and no throttles or extra replicas were left on at the end.","time":{"start":1794693897977,"end":1794693897995}}}
